name: Customer Refund Processing
goal: Resolve a customer's refund request with the correct terminal action (process_refund, reject_refund, or escalate) and correct parameters.
preconditions: A refund request references an order, identified by order id or searchable details.
The order's system delivery record, customer profile, and refund history may need to be looked up via tools before deciding.
procedure: Locate the order (search_orders/view_order) using the order id or details in the request.
Look up the customer profile (view_customer) to check VIP status.
Look up refund history (view_order_history) to check for frequent refunds.
Determine the applicable return window and whether the order is eligible.
Compute the correct amount and method if a refund should be issued.
Take exactly one terminal action: process_refund, reject_refund, or escalate, with the correct parameters.
